# Minimal confusables subset for unit testing.
# NOT the full Unicode TR#39 catalog — do not use in production.
# Production file: download from https://www.unicode.org/Public/security/latest/confusables.txt
#
# Format: <source_codepoint_hex> ; <target_codepoint_hex> ; <type> # comment
#
# Cyrillic → Latin lookalikes
0430 ;	0061 ;	SA	# ( а ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER A → ( a ) LATIN SMALL LETTER A
0435 ;	0065 ;	SA	# ( е ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER IE → ( e ) LATIN SMALL LETTER E
043E ;	006F ;	SA	# ( о ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER O → ( o ) LATIN SMALL LETTER O
0440 ;	0070 ;	SA	# ( р ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER ER → ( p ) LATIN SMALL LETTER P
0441 ;	0063 ;	SA	# ( с ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER ES → ( c ) LATIN SMALL LETTER C
0445 ;	0078 ;	SA	# ( х ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER HA → ( x ) LATIN SMALL LETTER X
0456 ;	0069 ;	SA	# ( і ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER BYELORUSSIAN-UKRAINIAN I → ( i ) LATIN SMALL LETTER I
0443 ;	0079 ;	SA	# ( у ) CYRILLIC SMALL LETTER U → ( y ) LATIN SMALL LETTER Y
#
# Greek → Latin lookalikes
03B1 ;	0061 ;	SA	# ( α ) GREEK SMALL LETTER ALPHA → ( a ) LATIN SMALL LETTER A
03BF ;	006F ;	SA	# ( ο ) GREEK SMALL LETTER OMICRON → ( o ) LATIN SMALL LETTER O
03C1 ;	0070 ;	SA	# ( ρ ) GREEK SMALL LETTER RHO → ( p ) LATIN SMALL LETTER P
